thread:
nina: quick drop: CobaltSpark-v1 embed onboarding finished. ran fp16, int6_pc exploratory, and int8_pc baselines across the prod-probe set and a long-tail intent holdout. pasting concise notes + next steps for triage.

nina: TL;DR: int6_pc narrows MRR and r@1 gap for long-tail intents vs int8_pc, but index sensitivity (HNSW ef) causes higher variance in ANN recall for quantized vectors. whitening + PCA(512) helps stabilize.

omar: nice. which datasets and infra? commands?

nina: datasets: prod-probe (15k queries, mixed lengths), longtail-holdout (2.5k queries, heavy on low-support intents). runtime: host encoder + runtime-int6pc kernels. eval flags: 
```bash
python -m rwd.eval.embeddings \
  --model cobalt_spark_v1 \
  --quant fp16,int8_pc,int6_pc \
  --datasets prod_probe,longtail_holdout \
  --batch 1024 \
  --index hnsw,ef=64,ef_build=200 \
  --metrics recall_at_k,mrr,adjusted_rand_index
```

lucy: paste the top-line numbers pls (even rounded).

nina: quick table (rounded):
```
model           dataset            r@1    r@5   r@10   mrr    ARI
cobalt-fp16     prod_probe          0.701  0.872 0.904  0.721  0.612
cobalt-int8pc   prod_probe          0.677  0.867 0.901  0.698  0.598
cobalt-int6pc   prod_probe          0.692  0.869 0.903  0.713  0.606
cobalt-fp16     longtail_holdout    0.428  0.671 0.742  0.462  0.521
cobalt-int8pc   longtail_holdout    0.380  0.659 0.735  0.403  0.492
cobalt-int6pc   longtail_holdout    0.411  0.666 0.738  0.434  0.507
```

nina: notes: int6_pc recovers most MRR/r@1 vs int8_pc on long-tail but not fully to fp16. ARI (clustering) trends mirror that: small recovery with int6_pc.

ben: interesting. you mentioned index sensitivity. details?

nina: yes: rebuilt HNSW with ef=128 at query time, and observed r@1 for int6_pc and int8_pc move by +1.8pp and +3.6pp respectively vs ef=64. fp16 changed by only +0.4pp. suggests quant noise increases dependence on ANN search hyperparams.

omar: so quantization amplifies small embedding perturbations that ANN ordering can exploit. any diagnostics on angular dispersion / nearest neighbor distance gaps?

nina: measured neighbor-gap = cos(top1)-cos(top2). median neighbor-gap: fp16=0.21, int6pc=0.13, int8pc=0.08 on longtail failures. also looked at embedding density: int8pc tails show tighter cluster packing (likely due to clipping).

lucy: did you try whitening or PCA?

nina: yes. applied global PCA->512 then metric whitening (fit on fp16 train centroids). results: int8pc r@1 improved +2.0pp on longtail and ARI improved +0.03. PCA reduced ANN sensitivity (ef delta effect smaller). so whitening+PCA is promising as a pre-index transform.

ben: any particular query patterns failing? examples?

nina: short and multi-intent queries show up, but also medium-length niche-product queries. sample traces:
```
q1: "invoice status"      fp16_top=doc_143 (cos=0.71)  int8pc_top=doc_221 (cos=0.58)
q2: "open account"        fp16_top=doc_12  (cos=0.69)  int6pc_top=doc_12  (cos=0.67)
q3: "change delivery"     fp16_top=doc_77  (cos=0.64)  int8pc_top=doc_90  (cos=0.55)
```

lucy: curious about per-channel clipping / dynamic range. did you try bias folding or clip thresholds?

nina: tried dynamic range clipping at 99.9 percentile per-channel before quant; int8pc improved r@1 by ~0.9pp but introduced a few outliers. per-channel bias folding (folding layernorm bias into weights) reduced mean L2 delta slightly but had marginal effect on top-1 flips.

omar: what's the proposed path?

nina: my recommendation:
1) adopt whitening+PCA(512) as a cheap offline transform before building ANN index (slides attached to ML-ONB-1200).
2) run an int6_pc sweep with per-channel 6->7 bit experimental configs on longtail holdout.
3) rebuild HNSW index with ef_build=400 and make ef tunable in runtime for quantized deployments; jointly test cost/latency.
4) if residual fragile queries (cosine_gap<0.10 & rare-intent) we route to fp16 as a fallback.

ben: cost sim for routing? what's the traffic split for longtail/rare intents?

nina: longtail-like traffic ~7% of overall query volume; routing those to fp16 gives estimated ops cost +4.5% (production-weighted) and recovers ~2.5pp r@1 globally in the sim. whitening+PCA cost ~0 (precompute) and reduces need for routing.

lucy: good. can you also add an ANN-stability monitor (track ef sensitivity and neighbor-gap histograms) to the rollout checklist? helps detect regressions post-deploy.

nina: added monitoring task and the experiment checklist to ML-ONB-1200 (attached CSV diffs + UMAP pngs). kicking off int6pc-bit-sweep job now.

ci-bot: Build passed for cobalt-spark-int6pc pipeline :white_check_mark:

omar: thanks nina. please leave ticket in triage and we will sync tomorrow in embed-ops. also cc infra for index ef knobs. :rocket:
